newsitem.title: USA: Typhoon approaches Japan with 105 mph winds.
newsitem.headline: Typhoon approaches Japan with 105 mph winds.

text.p: Typhoon Opal, with 105 mph winds, is approaching Japan and will make landfall within 24 hours in southern Honshu, independent forecaster Weather Services Corporation said.
Opal, near 29n/134e and moving north at 20 mph, may weaken slightly before landfall and will then accelerate northwards through Japan.
The storm will likely cause major damage to coastal property at and east of the landfall in southern Honshu, with winds up to 120 mph and a storm surge of up to 25 feet.

As the system moves northward the winds will diminish but very heavy to torrential rains will continue. Large areas of Honshu Japan can expect rains of 5 to 15 inches, bringing flooding and possible mudslides.
